problems: Cliopatria's row ends 1793 but the state ends 24 October 1795: new keyframe 1794-1795 (the 1792 rump shape) and a Third Partition dissolve with three successors.

Cliopatria draws the Electorate of Saxony inside the Commonwealth 1700-1756 (the 1709-1712 shape is Saxony alone, 32,669.8 km2, equal to Saxony's 1683-1699 shape) and the Saxony row has no shape 1700-1762: this dossier removes Saxony (personal union = association), so the electorate-of-saxony owner (eu-09) must supply 1700-1762 shapes or the map shows a hole.
Tobago (the Courlander colony) is inside the Commonwealth shapes 1640-41 and 1645-1658; removed.
The 1595-1599 Nalyvaiko drop (283 k km2) is marked wrong: the page gives 1594-1596 and no held territory; the nalyvaiko-uprising dossier (eu-16) uses the same dates.
The 1659-1661 shape (436 k km2) mixes occupations with cessions and still contains Vilnius and Kaunas; low-confidence adjust, to be redrawn from the occupation events.
Courland sits inside the Commonwealth shape to 1733 and has its own row only from 1734; covered by a vassal pair (confidence 2/1).
The Polish-Muscovite War article would not load under three titles; Truce of Deulino and Smolensk War were used instead. All 14 budgeted pages were spent.

Pro-Swedish Poland: Cliopatria's row runs 1706-1712 but the eu-15-k dossier 1704-1709; this dossier follows 1709 (Augustus regains the throne) and dates the Altranstädt loss October 1706 from the Great Northern War page against the other dossier's 14 September.
